title: Insulin depletion results in TGF-beta-induced epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition in liver epithelial cells: single-cell analysis code and figure-level data
description: Analysis code and derived figure-level data for Figure 6, Figure 7 and Figure S4 of the accompanying manuscript. The release preserves historical analysis scripts, frozen numerical inputs, final multi-panel assembly code and approved figures. It supports reconstruction of the final figure compositions from the supplied derived inputs; it is not a complete raw-count-to-figure reproduction package.
